metadata.schedule_summary: Reference plan: four 21-day cycles. Day 1: cisplatin and etoposide. Days 2–3: etoposide. Radiotherapy usually starts with cycle 1; its appointments are planned separately. Capsules, split cisplatin, a 28-day interval or a different platinum are used only if explicitly prescribed.

eligibility: Source indication; ECOG0–2; suitable candidate for radiation.
exclusions: Hypersensitivity, pregnancy/breastfeeding. Cisplatin: pre-existing neuropathy≥Grade2, CrCl<60, significant hearing impairment/tinnitus. Etoposide: severe hepatic impairment.
monitoring: Baseline blood, renal and liver profiles; audiology and creatinine clearance if indicated.
Blood, renal and liver profiles before every cycle; hearing/tinnitus and sensory symptoms by history before every cycle.
Monitor first15minutes of etoposide for hypotension; hydration/electrolyte and urine-output assessment around cisplatin.
RT planning, response imaging, optional tumour markers and post-course reviews follow the consultant plan; NCCP supplies no universal imaging or marker timetable.
dose_modifications: Fresh v8 counts and organ tables; exact table gaps and baseline/on-treatment discrepancy retained for review.
All modifications discussed with consultant. No unsourced Grade4 reduction or automatic platinum switch.

administration.notes: 1000 mL sodium chloride 0.9% over 1 hour; monitor first 15 minutes for hypotension. This fluid may serve as cisplatin prehydration under the local plan.
